title: Broccoli Rabe and Potato Shakshuka
changes_from_base: Tomato-free: a base of green peppers, jalapeños, potatoes simmered in stock and wilted broccoli rabe; the eggs are finished under a hot grill and dusted with Parmesan.
summary: A grilled vegetable base of potatoes, broccoli and peppers crowned with baked eggs finished under a hot grill.

ingredients.item: medium green peppers, seeded and cut in 1 cm dice
Yukon Gold or other all-rounder potatoes, peeled and cut in 1 cm dice
fine sea salt or table salt
vegetable stock (check stock label for celery)
broccoli rabe (cime di rapa), thick stems removed, finely chopped

steps.title: Sauté Vegetables
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp of 30 ml extra-virgin olive oil in a 30-35 cm cast-iron frying pan over medium heat; cook 140 g diced onion, 2 diced medium green peppers and 2 seeded, finely chopped jalapeños about 10 minutes until tender and starting to colour.

steps.title: Add Garlic
steps.text: Add 3 thinly sliced garlic cloves and cook 1-2 minutes, then add 340 g peeled and diced Yukon Gold potatoes; lower the heat slightly and cook 5 minutes, stirring now and then.

steps.title: Season Stock
steps.text: Season the vegetables with ¾ tsp fine salt, ¼ tsp ground black pepper and 1 tbsp fresh thyme leaves; pour in 360 ml vegetable stock and cook over medium-low about 15 minutes until most of the liquid has evaporated and the potatoes are tender.

steps.title: Add Greens
steps.text: Add 450 g finely chopped broccoli rabe (thick stems removed) and cook, stirring, until wilted and reduced; fold in ½ tsp chilli flakes and check the seasoning, then turn off the heat and smooth the vegetables.

steps.title: Grill
steps.text: Heat the grill to high with a shelf near the top; make 4 shallow hollows and crack a large egg into each.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Grill 1½-2 minutes until the egg whites are set and the yolks still runny; dust each egg with finely grated Parmesan and drizzle with the remaining oil before serving.

tips: Cut all the vegetables to a similar size so they cook evenly throughout
The broccoli rabe will reduce significantly, so don't be alarmed at the initial volume
For pregnant, very young, elderly or immunocompromised eaters, grill about 1 minute longer so the yolks are firm (71 °C)
storage: Serve straight away. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
